# Accumulation/Distribution

*Running total of volume weighted by the close within the range.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Accumulation/Distribution** under **Volume**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.
